title: Clinical Observation
description: Structured clinical observation recording type, value, units, timestamp, and practitioner details

observationType.title: Observation Type
observationType.description: Type of clinical observation (e.g., blood pressure, temperature, heart rate)

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., mmHg, bpm, celsius)

observationDate.title: Observation Date
observationDate.description: Date and time the observation was recorded

practitioner.title: Practitioner
practitioner.description: Name or identifier of the recording practitioner

disclosure.recommendation: Clinical observations contain patient health data. Only disclose to healthcare professionals with a direct care relationship. Restrict from administrative and non-clinical participants.
